name: Aspen triage report
notes:
Aspen triage report v2.2. 
Report order triage start time from earliest to latest within the selected time period. 
Report provides a summary of happenings in Triage, including  all patients that have been Triaged within the specified time period: 
- triage score (1-5)
- triage encounter start time (DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM AM/PM) - triage encounters include encounter types triage, admission, observation and emergency. 
- triage encounter end time (DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM AM/PM - if ended, blank encounter still ongoing) 
- discharge status (active admission (encounter ongoing at time of report generation) / discharged (triage encounter discharged)). Statuses include triage admission (patient is still in traige), inpatient admission (patient has moved from triage into an inpatient bed, even if they are discharged from ED and readmitted to hospital - looks for any hospital admissions where the admission time is within 5 hours after discharge from a triage encounter), discharged from triage, discharged from inpatient admission (discharged from the hospital admission following the triage encounter)
- dIscharge disposition (if pnt discharged from triage encounter, can see if patient admitted to hospital or went home from this column)
- current location (if the encounter is still going, location of the patient)
